page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs using the x86_64 architecture, powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource sharing at the thread level.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-to-vCPU ratio position this instance for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without hyperthreading interference. It is suitable for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, and enterprise workloads that demand dedicated processor cores and a high memory footprint.
